name: push-through
title: Push Through
description: The outgoing scene is pushed toward the camera and blurs away while the next scene arrives from behind it. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .pth-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: A scene change that should feel like moving forward through the frame.
Product or feature reveals: the camera pushes past one idea into the next.
avoidWhen: You want a flat wipe or slide with no depth: use a wipe or slide block.
The scenes carry small text that must stay readable through the change.
author: Remocn
